name: VAT in the Digital Age (ViDA)
short_description: VAT in the Digital Age (ViDA) is an EU legislative package that modernises the VAT system with three pillars: digital reporting and e-invoicing, platform economy rules and single VAT registration. The episode treats it as a shift to continuous transaction controls.

evidence.quote: VITA is the EU admitting the obvious VAT has to operate at transaction speed.
Most organizations read VIDA as three separate work streams.
